title: Find a compact permissively licensed Python identity packet
description: Find and pin a compact, complete-file Python repository scope with strong identity or national-identifier semantics and a permissive/approved license. Prefer a smaller authored target over the 1,794-line YJDH models.py candidate. Prepare only scanner-blind proposed labels and a human-review packet; do not accept labels without review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Selected the compact YJDH employee serializer instead of the 1,794-line model: 93 complete authored Python lines, MIT license, explicit Finnish HETU/social-security-number validation, and 19 scanner-blind proposed data-item decisions. Exact materialization and manifest tests pass. No label is accepted or counted.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Proposed YJDH employee packet is on develop via PR #5 (tests/benchmark/repos/yjdh-employee/). Closing this find-and-prepare sub-task. Acceptance remains DATAP-c66199.
